item.title: Talking to External APIs with Fetch
item.description: Remember the ancient days of XMLHttpRequest with its twenty lines of event setup just to load a single JSON file? Yeah… let’s never go back there. :v Modern browsers give us the native Fetch API. It’s built right into the browser, works natively with Promises, and makes communicating with backend REST endpoints smooth and pleasant. Here’s my quick reference guide on using it effectively. 1.
